newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil firmer.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was slightly stronger on Tuesday as crude oil futures rose and the market remained well supplied, traders said.
Low sulphur cargoes were assessed a couple of dollars firmer at around $112 fob NWE but buyers were scarce.
High sulphur straight-run Russian fuel oil continues to emerge from the Baltics and dealers expected premiums to the E-4 formula to be a dollar or less.
